subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of 14 third-party action updates on the final stable head, including actions that receive secrets or publish artifacts?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically correct, but it changes code executing across credentialed release, token, Codex, Docker, and security-scanning workflows and carries a protected security label.

options.title: Approve grouped update
options.body: Accept the official immutable pins after final-head provenance review and required workflow checks.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, token, Docker-publishing, Blacksmith, and CodeQL updates for narrower trust-boundary review and rollback.

options.title: Regenerate later
options.body: Close and regenerate a fresh Dependabot group only if repeated rebases prevent a stable reviewable head.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped update
recommendation.body: Accept the official immutable pins after final-head provenance review and required workflow checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to release workflow operation and Docker release hardening among the affected surfaces.
